answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 87 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a karst bet on surviving 87 epochs of grading, and every forge settlement recomputes the jetty schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
